PDF Real-Time Ray-Casting and Advanced Shading of Discrete Isosurfaces
Abstract This paper presents a real-time rendering pipeline for implicit surfaces de ned by a regular volumetric grid of samples. We use a ray-casting approach on current graphics hardware to perform a direct rendering of the isosurface.
